_about: A message's status follows its replies: resolved when one settles it, else replied (the first rule wins, so the order matters); a message that is not a reply must name a recipient; a message past its due date and not resolved is flagged (answers CM3).

rules.why: What was asked is settled when a reply says so; the status is derived so nobody edits a message. Declared before the replied rule: a derived value is set once, so a message with a resolving reply among others is resolved.
A message with an answer is no longer pending; it stays open until a reply settles it.

then.flag: a message that answers nothing must say whom it is for

rules.why: A message nobody receives waits for nobody; a reply reaches whoever asked, so it may name no one.

then.flag: a message is past its due date and not resolved

rules.why: A question nobody answered by the date it was needed is a blocked item staying blocked; the plan must say so.
